title: Mera naam Hussaini hai mera kaam hai maatam
body:
Mera naam Hussaini hai mera kaam hai maatam
<<DIVIDER>>
Ya Hussain
Qariya qariya aa gaya kucha kucha gaya
Har jagah zikr e aal e mohammed kiya
Milgaya jis jagah mujhko farsh e aza
Apni pehchan karwayi hai iss tarha
Naam hai mera azadare Hussain
Kaam mera maatam e Hussain hai
Kya fikr ho duniya ki mujhe kya ho bhala gham (2)
<<MINI>>
Hai saaya bhi manzar pe alamdaar ka parcham
Mera naam Hussaini hai mera kaam hai maatam (2)
<<DIVIDER>>
Maulai mujhe ye kehta hai saara zamana
Tauqeer mujhe deta hai Zehra ka gharana
Kehta hai mujhe zakir e shabeer e do alam
<<MINI>>
Hai saaya bhi manzar pe alamdaar ka parcham

<<DIVIDER>>
Pehchaan meri saare zamane pe ayaan hai
